summary: ConnectOne Bancorp, Inc. filed a routine Form 8-K on October 8, 2026, to announce its third quarter 2026 earnings release and conference call. The Company will report results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, before market open on Thursday, October 22, 2026, followed by a 10:00 a.m. ET call hosted by Chairman/CEO Frank Sorrentino III and CFO William S. Burns. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are stated; this is an ordinary scheduling notice and not a special situation. Watch for Q3 fundamentals, net interest margin, credit quality, and any strategic updates on the call.
